analyzed_vuln.description: Use-after-free is caused by xmlXIncludeIncludeNode freeing the original xi:include node (xmlFreeNode(cur) in the XML_PARSE_NOXINCNODE path) after reparenting included/fallback children with xmlAddPrevSibling, without ensuring namespace pointers on moved nodes remain valid. The freed include node owns namespace declarations (including xi), and freeing it releases ns objects (xmlFreeNsList). Descendant nodes that still reference those ns structs via node->ns become dangling. Later serialization in xmlNodeDumpOutputInternal dereferences cur->ns->prefix, triggering UAF.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: In the xml fuzz harness, input is parsed via xmlReadMemory with attacker-controlled parser options. Trigger requires XML_PARSE_XINCLUDE and XML_PARSE_NOXINCNODE so xmlXIncludeProcessFlags reaches xmlXIncludeIncludeNode's NOXINCNODE branch. A crafted xi:include with fallback/content that is spliced into the tree and still points to namespace declarations from the include node causes stale ns pointers after xmlFreeNode(cur). Subsequent xmlDocDumpMemory traversal of the resulting document dereferences freed namespace memory and crashes.
